objective.summary: Agree on the issue, root cause, owning-boundary resolution, fix evals, and build goal prompt.
success_criteria: Required reviewers approve the same issue, root cause, resolution, and eval set.
non_goals: Implement the fix inside the consensus review.

fix_evals.purpose: Prove the old bad state is rejected at the owning boundary.
fix_evals.expected_failure_before_fix: test fails because the owner permits the bad value
fix_evals.expected_pass_after_fix: test passes and the bad value is rejected before persistence

orchestration.pasteable_goal_prompt: /goal Fix the diagnosed owner-seam bug using .codex/diagnose/sample-diagnosis.json.

reviewers.one_job: Confirm the issue and root-cause chain from evidence.

loop_control.stop_gate: approved by all required reviewers or blocked on repeated evidence gap

consensus.agreed_resolution: Move the invariant into the owner seam and add a regression eval.
